title: UPinebox
description: This mod adds Pineapple gear , uranium liquid, blocks, multi tools, crafting recipes, and more items that you can see when you check out the mod
body:
This mod is now approved by the moderators so it is a public mod now
Details about the mod:
- Box- it is a storage block
- Pine paxle- is a multi-tool
- Pineapple blocks- they are building blocks
- Box stairs and slabs- also building blocks
- Pine village- village made by the blocks in the mod
- Fake box- neutral mob that you can ride on
- Pineapplified- potion effect that does nothing yet :)
- Piniome and Box biome- Biomes that are still glitchy in the terrain generation
- Pinevillager- It is a villager that has the Pinevillager job (it is a honey block)
- Pineapple acquired- it is an advancment
- Box dimension- adds a new dimension with the pineiome in it
- Adds more crafting recipes 
 
- That is it for update 1.1.1. for now. Hope you enjoy!
